title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
short: Traditional (French tune, 1761; words by · C 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: Three chords, C, F and G, and a tune you already know. Pick the tune first: it lives on the first three frets, with the open strings doing much of the work. Then strum the chords with the island strum (down, down-up, miss, up-down-up), changing chord on beat 3 when two chords share a bar.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: The French song “Ah! vous dirai-je, maman” with the English poem “The Star”

sources.name: Melody as in our piano version of Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, which was checked against the theme of Mozart’s Variations on “Ah vous dirai-je, maman”, K. 265 (Mutopia Project, public domain). The chords follow that version’s left hand. Our checking script compares the two melodies beat by beat.
